data.label: 角色 rim 边缘光 + 接地阴影 + 受击闪白（单机/联机英雄）

content.text:
你是 Godot 4.7 GDScript 项目的视觉开发。项目：C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king（HonorKing，3D MOBA，mobile 渲染器，Android 目标；无测试套件，Godot 可执行文件 D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe）。

背景：Lead 正在做“画面质感”批次，已完成全屏后处理（scripts/core/PostFX.gd + postfx.gdshader，autoload PostFX）、Environment 调参、字体。你的任务是把“角色可读性”补上：英雄模型的 rim 边缘光、脚下接地阴影、受击闪白。用户要求直接开工、视觉只做表现不改战斗逻辑，验证从简（不做完整试玩）。

## 目标（只做英雄，不做小兵/塔）
1. 新增 `scripts/core/unit_rim.gdshader`：spatial shader，`render_mode blend_add, unshaded, cull_back, depth_draw_never;`
   - uniforms：`rim_color:vec4`、`rim_power`(默认2.2)、`rim_strength`(0.75)、`hit`(0..1，受击闪白)、`hit_color`(白)。
   - fragment：`float f = pow(1.0 - clamp(dot(NORMAL, VIEW), 0.0, 1.0), rim_power);` 输出 `ALBEDO = mix(rim_color.rgb * rim_strength, hit_color.rgb, clamp(hit,0,1)) * f + hit_color.rgb * hit * 0.22; ALPHA = 1.0;`（加法混合，只加边缘光，不覆盖模型贴图）。
2. 新增 `scripts/core/blob_shadow.gdshader`：spatial shader，透明黑色软圆接地阴影（`render_mode unshaded, blend_mix, depth_draw_never, cull_disabled, shadows_disabled, fog_disabled;`），fragment 用 `UV` 计算圆内软边 alpha（内部约0.30、边缘平滑到0，可加一点低频噪声避免死板），输出 `ALBEDO=vec3(0); ALPHA=alpha;`。
3. 新增 `scripts/core/UnitVisuals.gd`（class_name UnitVisuals，全部 static 或通过实例管理均可）：
   - `attach_hero(unit: Node3D, team: int, model_root: Node3D) -> void`：递归遍历 model_root 下所有 `MeshInstance3D`，给每个设置 `material_overlay = 独立的 ShaderMaterial`（unit_rim，`rim_color` = 队伍色：team 0 青 (0.25,0.85,1.0)、team 1 红 (1.0,0.4,0.32)；给英雄本人可略高 rim_strength）。把每个材质记在 unit 的 meta 里（如 `unit.set_meta("_fx_rim_mats", mats)`），供闪白用。**必须保留原材质/base 贴图**，只用 material_overlay 叠加。
   - 接地阴影：在 unit 下创建 `MeshInstance3D`（name "BlobShadow"），`PlaneMesh` size (1,1)、`rotation.x = -PI/2`、`position.y = 0.03`、`mesh.material = 独立 blob_shadow 材质`、`cast_shadow = OFF`、`material_override`；缩放 = `unit.body_radius * 2.4`（body_radius 不存在时用 0.9）。**隐藏规则**：unit 不可见 / 兰陵王隐身（`unit.display_name == "兰陵王" and unit.lanling_stealth_active`）/ 阵亡（`unit.is_dead`）时隐藏；用一个小 helper Node（`UnitVisuals.BlobFollower extends Node3D`）每帧同步，或复用 unit 的 process，自行选简单方案。僵尸/分身等特殊模型不要管。
   - `flash(unit: Node3D) -> void`：把所有 rim 材质的 `hit` 设为 1.0，然后 Tween 在 0.18s 内回 0（`create_tween` 在 unit 上；若 unit 已有 tween 冲突可用 `set_meta` 存 tween 并 kill 旧 tween）。玩家/任意英雄通用。
4. 单机接入 `scripts/entities/Hero.gd` 的 `_create_visual()`（约 line 818）：在 `add_child(visual_mesh)`（约 835）之后、以及 fallback 分支 `visual_mesh = fallback`（约 848）之后，调用 `UnitVisuals.attach_hero(self, team, visual_mesh)`。注意 `_create_visual` 在 `_ready` 前/后被调用都行，但要确保 `team` 已赋值（若不确定可延后一帧 `call_deferred`）。兰陵王隐身、张飞变身缩放、`_set_node_alpha` 冻结/隐身逻辑都不能被破坏（只用 material_overlay + 独立 BlobShadow 子节点）。
5. 受击闪白接入 `scripts/entities/GameEntity.gd` 的 `take_damage()`：在“扣血后、未死亡”分支调用 `UnitVisuals.flash(self)`（对没有 rim 材质的实体是空操作，不能报错；死亡那一击也可以闪）。只加这一行逻辑，别改伤害计算。
6. 联机客户端接入 `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd`：找到远端英雄视觉节点创建处（搜索 `CapsuleMesh`/`_hero_nodes`/`_apply_snapshot` 里建英雄模型的位置，约 line 1350 附近以及 `_hero_visuals`），对每个远端英雄模型调用 `UnitVisuals.attach_hero(node_root, team, model_root)`；并在已有 `_prev_hp` 掉血检测处（约 line 3025-3035，已有伤害数字逻辑）对本地关注的英雄调用 `UnitVisuals.flash(对应节点)`。客户端没有 Hero 实体，节点可能是 Node3D/其他，确保 UnitVisuals 的接口对非 Hero 节点容错（用 `unit.get("body_radius")`/`unit.get("is_dead")` 之类）。

## 约束
- 允许改动的文件仅：新增 `scripts/core/unit_rim.gdshader`、`scripts/core/blob_shadow.gdshader`、`scripts/core/UnitVisuals.gd`；修改 `scripts/entities/Hero.gd`、`scripts/entities/GameEntity.gd`、`scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd`。**不要动** scripts/core/MapVisuals.gd、PostFX.gd、project.godot、UI/NetSession/商店/面板文件。
- 只做视觉，不改战斗数值/时序；不要启动完整游戏长时间试玩。
- 移动端性能优先：不要给每个 MeshInstance 加第二份网格，不要屏幕后处理；material_overlay 控制在每模型 1 层。
- 验证：
  a) `cd 'C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king'; & 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --path . --editor --quit`（仅允许既有 `Class "Minimap" hides a global script class` 告警）。
  b) `... --headless --path . res://scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after 240`：不得有 SCRIPT ERROR（日志/证书噪声除外）。
  c) 窗口化真实渲染验证：写一个临时探针场景（`res://_probe_char.tscn` + gd，用后删除）加载 `res://scenes/battle.tscn`（作为子节点或 change_scene 后再挂常驻节点），跑到有英雄模型后截一张图：`await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw` 后 `get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png("res://_shot_char.png")`。确认无运行时报错、英雄边缘有青/红轮廓、脚下有软阴影。把 `_shot_char.png` 留在工作区根目录（不要删除这张图），其它临时文件删掉。
- 完成后 send_message 给 lead：改动摘要、接入点行号、验证结论、截图路径；然后不要做别的。

工作流：用 team_task_list 找 task-7（我已建好），team_task_get 后 claim 再动手，完成时 complete。若任务不存在直接开工（但优先 claim）。

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)

用户时间与预算有限，**每个任务都必须为省时间/省 token 服务**：

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。
- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

</system-reminder>

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

static func flash(unit: Node3D) -> void:
    if unit == null or not is_instance_valid(unit): return
    var mats: Array = unit.get_meta("_fx_rim_mats", [])
    if mats.is_empty(): return
    for m in mats:

    if old is Tween and old.is_valid():

    if not unit.is_inside_tree():

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
a=np.asarray(Image.open("_fx_shot.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)
b=np.asarray(Image.open("_fx_base.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)

    ys,xs=np.where(mask)
    print(nm,"px",int(mask.sum()),"bbox x",(xs.min(),xs.max()) if len(xs) else None,"y",(ys.min(),ys.max()) if len(ys) else None,"mean_drgb",d[mask].mean(axis=0).round(1) if len(xs) else None)
# separate by x to identify which hero: cyan at x~-3.5, red at 0, red at 3.5

dh=hit-a

        print(row)
print("== rim positive map =="); amap(np.maximum(d.mean(axis=2),0))
print("== shadow negative map =="); amap(np.maximum(-d.mean(axis=2),0))
print("== hit positive map =="); amap(np.maximum(dh.mean(axis=2),0))
'@","description":"Analyze static FX probe diff maps"}

{"command":"$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'; & 'C:\Users\18749\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe' -c @'
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
a=np.asarray(Image.open("_fx_shot.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)
b=np.asarray(Image.open("_fx_base.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)
hit=np.asarray(Image.open("_fx_hit.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)
d=a-b
print("FX diff>6:",int((np.abs(d).max(axis=2)>6).sum()))
pos=(a.sum(axis=2)>b.sum(axis=2)+12)
neg=(b.sum(axis=2)>a.sum(axis=2)+12)
for nm,mask in [("rim(+ brighter)",pos),("shadow(- darker)",neg)]:
    ys,xs=np.where(mask)
    print(nm,"px",int(mask.sum()),"bbox x",(xs.min(),xs.max()) if len(xs) else None,"y",(ys.min(),ys.max()) if len(ys) else None,"mean_drgb",d[mask].mean(axis=0).round(1) if len(xs) else None)
# separate by x to identify which hero: cyan at x~-3.5, red at 0, red at 3.5
for x0,x1,label in [(0,500,"left(cyan)"),(500,900,"mid(red)"),(900,1280,"right(red)")]:
    sub=np.zeros_like(pos); sub[:,x0:x1]=pos[:,x0:x1]
    ys,xs=np.where(sub)
    print(label,"rim px",int(sub.sum()),"mean_drgb",d[sub].mean(axis=0).round(1) if len(xs) else None,"bbox y",(ys.min(),ys.max()) if len(ys) else None)
# hit vs shot
dh=hit-a
posh=(hit.sum(axis=2)>a.sum(axis=2)+12)
ys,xs=np.where(posh)
print("hit brighter px",int(posh.sum()),"bbox",(xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max()) if len(xs) else None,"mean_drgb",dh[posh].mean(axis=0).round(1) if len(xs) else None)
def amap(mat,step=16,thr=(4,10,25),chars=" .+#"):
    H,W=mat.shape
    for y in range(0,H,step):
        row=""
        for x in range(0,W,step):
            blk=mat[y:y+step,x:x+step]
            v=blk.mean() if blk.size else 0
            row += chars[3] if v>thr[2] else (chars[2] if v>thr[1] else (chars[1] if v>thr[0] else chars[0]))
        print(row)
print("== rim positive map =="); amap(np.maximum(d.mean(axis=2),0))
print("== shadow negative map =="); amap(np.maximum(-d.mean(axis=2),0))
print("== hit positive map =="); amap(np.maximum(dh.mean(axis=2),0))
'@","description":"Analyze static FX probe diff maps"}

{"command":"$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'; & 'C:\Users\18749\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe' -c @'
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
a=np.asarray(Image.open("_fx_shot.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)
b=np.asarray(Image.open("_fx_base.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)
hit=np.asarray(Image.open("_fx_hit.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)
d=a-b; dh=hit-a
# virtual viewport 2400x1400 -> window 1280x720 mapping observed via unproject
s=1280/2400
centers={"Arthur(cyan)":(1038.3*s,700*s),"XiaoQiao(red)":(1244.0*s,700*s),"Lanling(red)":(1449.7*s,700*s)}
for name,(cx,cy) in centers.items():
    x0,x1=int(cx-60),int(cx+60); y0,y1=int(cy-150),int(cy+20)
    sub=d[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    pos=(sub.sum(axis=2)>12); neg=(-sub.sum(axis=2)>12)
    # rim = upper part (body), shadow = lower part (feet)
    print(name,"window center",(round(cx),round(cy)))
    print("  rim pos px",int(pos.sum()),"mean drgb",sub[pos].mean(axis=0).round(1) if pos.any() else None)
    print("  shadow neg px",int(neg.sum()),"mean drgb",sub[neg].mean(axis=0).round(1) if neg.any() else None)
    subh=dh[y0:y1,x0:x1]; posh=(subh.sum(axis=2)>12)
    print("  hit pos px",int(posh.sum()),"mean drgb",subh[posh].mean(axis=0).round(1) if posh.any() else None)
# whole-frame summary of hit uniformity: fraction of hero bbox pixels brightened
box=(slice(350,470),slice(500,800))
print("global hit diff px",int((np.abs(dh).max(axis=2)>6).sum()),"max dh",dh.max())
'@","description":"Per-hero window diff analysis"}

{"command":"$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'; & 'C:\Users\18749\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe' -c @'
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
a=np.asarray(Image.open("_shot_char.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)
b=np.asarray(Image.open("_shot_base.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)
hit=np.asarray(Image.open("_shot_hit.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)
d=a-b; dh=hit-a
print("frame",a.shape)
pos=(d.sum(axis=2)>12); neg=(-d.sum(axis=2)>12)
print("boundary diff>6:",int((np.abs(d).max(axis=2)>6).sum()),"pos",int(pos.sum()),"neg",int(neg.sum()))
for nm,mask in [("rim+",pos),("shadow-",neg)]:
    ys,xs=np.where(mask)
    if len(xs): print(nm,"bbox",(xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max()),"mean_drgb",d[mask].mean(axis=0).round(1))
# center region likely player hero: find where neg strongest
sub=np.maximum(-d.mean(axis=2),0)
ys,xs=np.where(sub>8)
print("strong shadow pixels",len(xs),"bbox",(xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max()) if len(xs) else None)
print("hit diff px",int((np.abs(dh).max(axis=2)>6).sum()),"max",dh.max(),"mean pos drgb",dh[dh.sum(axis=2)>12].mean(axis=0).round(1))
step=16
chars=" .+#@"
print("== diff (pos rim / neg shadow) map ==")
for y in range(0,900,step):
    row=""
    for x in range(0,1600,step):
        v=d[y:y+step,x:x+step].mean()
        row += "+" if v>4 else ("-" if v<-4 else " ")
    print(row)
'@","description":"Analyze frozen battle screenshot diff"}

{"file_path":"_probe_char.gd","new_string":"	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	_save("res://_shot_char.png")

	# 调试：把玩家英雄的 BlobShadow 换成亮红不透明材质，验证几何是否被地面遮挡
	var dbg_hero = battle.hero
	var dbg_blob = dbg_hero.get_node_or_null("BlobShadow")

		_save("res://_shot_debug.png")
		# 还原 shader 材质由 attach 时创建，这里仅恢复为无 override 前记录的原材质
		dbg_blob.material_override = UnitVisuals.new().blob_material_for_debug() if false else dbg_blob.material_override

But wait: that visual displacement affects the ground only; blob would be partially occluded in bumpy areas. On lanes (lane_m=1) height stays y=0.05 flat. Heroes fight on lanes and jungle.

So bob shadow needs a robust solution. Options:

A) Use `depth_test_disabled` on blob shader → always renders over ground regardless of decals/bumps. Draws over hero feet (acceptable) and over anything in front (minions etc.) — since transparent pass sorted by distance, blob at hero position sorted; it will draw over previously drawn transparent objects behind it but any opaque drawn already — with depth test disabled it draws over ALL opaque including the hero itself where overlapping. The blob is at ground, so overlap with hero only at feet region; with alpha ~0.3 dark, looks like contact darkening on feet — arguably fine. Also in front of hero (between camera and hero) no issue; objects in front of hero (closer to camera) would get darkened if they overlap the blob's screen projection: e.g., a minion standing in front of the hero could receive a dark oval over its body. Since blob is under hero and hero is usually tallest, the occluding overlap is mostly the hero itself.

B) Raise blob to y=0.3 (above high ground 0.225, fountain 0.3?) Fountain disc y=0.3 exactly. Jungle peaks 0.26. So y=0.32 works globally, but then the shadow floats 0.34 above flat lanes → from camera pitch -60°, a 3.6m circle 0.34 above ground will appear offset relative to hero feet by 0.34/tan(60°)? Projection offset along ground ~0.2m toward camera; barely noticeable. Also it would draw above the model's feet but below body; since depth tested against hero model, part behind feet hidden. Actually floating 0.34 above ground could visibly overlap hero legs region in screen space and appear as a dark band on ankles? Hmm.

C) Keep y=0.03 plus render with depth_test_disabled only for ground decals? Not possible selectively.

D) Use a decal-like approach on ground via material overlay? Decal node would project onto geometry properly (Decal in Godot projects onto surfaces, works with multiple heights). A Decal with texture would naturally conform to ground and follow terrain. But mobile renderer supports decals? Decals are supported in Mobile renderer in Godot 4? Decals are not supported in Mobile renderer! (Godot docs: decals not supported in mobile renderer). So no.

E) Sample ground height: implement `BlobFollower` that raycasts downward (physics) to find ground collider — but collider is flat box at y=-0.1 top surface y=-0.05, uniform. Doesn't know visual decals. Could compute lane/high-ground/fountain analytically replicated — coupling and complexity. Not great.

F) Raise blob a bit (0.07) above lanes, and accept occlusion in jungle bumps/high ground. That's a partial solution: visible on lanes (most fights) but invisible in jungle bumps (random). Bad randomness.

G) Use `depth_draw_never` + `depth_test_disabled` but with `render_priority` set low and draw only additive? It's black mix. Overlap issue.

H) Make the blob follow ground *visual* height by sampling the same analytic formula as MapVisuals? Since UnitVisuals allowed to modify only its own file—could replicate bump formula? That's coupling to MapVisuals internals prohibited? Not prohibited, but bad.

I) Alternative contact shadow: use a vertical-gradient cylinder? no.

Hmm. What do other MOBA-ish games do? They use a projected decal or render blob in a separate overlay pass (depth test relative to ground). Since we're constrained, option A (depth_test_disabled) with alpha 0.3 is common for fake blob shadows; the darkening of own feet is minimal because blob is centered under model and model's feet usually near center where shadow is darkest but hero geometry occupies those pixels — wait with depth_test_disabled, blob draws OVER the hero mesh pixels in overlap region (feet/legs lower part). Because transparent pass drawn after opaque; depth test disabled → draws regardless. The screen projection of a horizontal disc at y=0.03: from the camera, the hero's legs occupy pixels that overlap the disc projection significantly (the disc appears as ellipse under/behind feet; the model's feet may overlap upper part of ellipse). This would tint the lower legs dark — looks like ambient occlusion contact darkening, arguably desirable ("grounding").

But it also draws over the hero's attack range ring? irrelevant.

Also it would draw over the fountain disc (transparent) depending sorting; fine.

What about water shader transparent? water is opaque per comment.

Bigger concern: overlapping UI? no, 3D only.

	var blob = node.get_node_or_null("BlobShadow")
	print("[CLIENTPROBE] mats=", mats.size(), " blob=", blob != null,
		" blob_scale=", (blob.scale.x if blob != null else -1.0),

	UnitVisuals.attach_hero(node, 1, node)
	print("[CLIENTPROBE] after re-attach mats=", (node.get_meta("_fx_rim_mats", []) as Array).size(),
		" blob_count=", node.get_children().filter(func(c): return c.name == "BlobShadow").size())

	var plain := Node3D.new()
	add_child(plain)

	print("[CLIENTPROBE] plain flash ok, mats=", (plain.get_meta("_fx_rim_mats", []) as Array).size())
	# 等 tween 走完，确认 hit 归零
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.4).timeout
	print("[CLIENTPROBE] hit after 0.4s=", str(mats[0].get_shader_parameter("hit") if mats.size() > 0 else null))
	print("[CLIENTPROBE] blob_visible(stealth-free)=", (blob.visible if blob != null else null))
	get_tree().quit()
","file_path":"_probe_client.gd"}

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
a=np.asarray(Image.open("_shot_char.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)
b=np.asarray(Image.open("_shot_base.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)
h=np.asarray(Image.open("_shot_hit.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)
dbg=np.asarray(Image.open("_shot_debug.png").convert("RGB")).astype(np.int16)
d=a-b; dh=h-a
pos=(d.sum(axis=2)>12); neg=(-d.sum(axis=2)>12)
print("pos(rim)",int(pos.sum()),"neg(shadow)",int(neg.sum()))
for nm,mask in [("rim+",pos),("shadow-",neg)]:
    ys,xs=np.where(mask)
    print(nm,"bbox",(xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max()),"mean drgb",d[mask].mean(axis=0).round(1))
# cluster by color for rim: cyan-ish vs red-ish
ys,xs=np.where(pos)
subd=d[pos]; subrgb=a[pos]
cyan=(subd[:,2]>subd[:,0]+8)&(subd[:,1]>subd[:,0]+4)
red=(subd[:,0]>subd[:,2]+8)
print("rim cyan px",int(cyan.sum()),"mean drgb",subd[cyan].mean(axis=0).round(1) if cyan.any() else None,
      "bbox", (xs[cyan].min(),xs[cyan].max(),ys[cyan].min(),ys[cyan].max()) if cyan.any() else None)
print("rim red px",int(red.sum()),"mean drgb",subd[red].mean(axis=0).round(1) if red.any() else None,
      "bbox", (xs[red].min(),xs[red].max(),ys[red].min(),ys[red].max()) if red.any() else None)

      "bbox",(xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max()) if posh.any() else None)
mg=(dbg[:,:,0]>120)&(dbg[:,:,2]>120)&(dbg[:,:,1]<80)
ys,xs=np.where(mg)
print("debug blob magenta px",len(xs),"bbox",(xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max()) if len(xs) else None)
# ascii of full diff for composition
step=24
print("== full diff map (+rim / -shadow) ==")
for y in range(0,900,step):
    row=""
    for x in range(0,1600,step):
        v=d[y:y+step,x:x+step].mean()
        row += "+" if v>4 else ("-" if v<-4 else " ")
    print(row)
'@","description":"Analyze close-up battle screenshot metrics"}

Potential risk: "Tween created during draw" not an error. Fine.

B) **技能前摇**：`Skill.gd` 加 `@export var cast_time := 0.0`；Hero.gd 按 type 给默认前摇（0→0.14s、1→0.20s、3→0.16s、4→0.10s、6→0.10s），type 2/5、channeling、沈梦溪/太乙真人/元流之子/马超的专属多段技能保持 0；`_start_casting` 记倒计时，`_physics_process` 里倒计时归零才 `_finish_casting()`；前摇期间移速 ×0.55、禁普攻、预览照常；被 stun/knockup/froze/suppress/silence/死亡打断则取消（不扣蓝不进 CD、清 pending/预览），前摇期间重复按技能键忽略。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

{"id":"task-23","revision":1,"subject":"手感 P0-A：走 A + 技能前摇（Hero.gd）","description":"目标：把手感拉向王者荣耀 —— ①移动中可普攻（走 A）；②技能加短前摇（施法期间减速、可被打断）。只改 scripts/entities/Hero.gd（如需新增字段可改 assets/Skill.gd）。

【A. 走 A（重点）】
- 现状：Hero.gd `_physics_process` 里只有 `move_vec≈0`（站定）的 else 分支才 `_perform_attack`（约 1623~1637 行）。移动中按住普攻/锁定目标完全不出手。
- 要求：把「目标获取 + 是否出手」从站定分支提到移动分支之前/共用（`_get_attack_target()`、`should_attack` 判定沿用：按住 ui_accept 或 TouchController.get_attack_held() 或 manual_target 有效或推塔/小兵模式），移动中若 `attack_timer<=0` 且无控制/无 `casting_skill` 也执行 `_perform_attack(target)` 并重置 `attack_timer=1.0/attack_speed`。
- 动画：现在移动分支每帧 `_play_anim("walk")` 会把攻击动作立刻覆盖。加 `var _aa_anim_until := 0.0`（`Time.get_ticks_msec()/1000.0` 或自增计时），`_perform_attack` 里设 `_aa_anim_until = now + clampf(0.6/attack_speed, 0.12, 0.30)`；移动分支只在 `now > _aa_anim_until` 时 `_play_anim("walk")`（攻击动作播完自动回 walk，继续移动不中断）。
- 不要破坏英雄专属强化普攻（马超/铠/后羿/元流之子、`_enhanced_aa_queued()`、`manual_target` 追击仅 AI 等既有分支）；玩家仍不自动追击（P1 再做）。
- 验收：探针里 `Input.action_press("ui_accept")` + `Input.action_press("ui_up")/("ui_right")` 持续 1.2s：打印玩家 `global_position` 在变化 AND 期间至少触发 2 次攻击（可用 `attack_timer` 或对木桩/小兵造成伤害/子弹计数验证）；停止移动后仍正常站桩普攻；BP→加载→开局冒烟正常。

【B. 技能前摇】
- 现状：`_start_casting()` 置 `casting_skill=true` 后下一物理帧 `_finish_casting()` 立刻出手（Skill.gd 里没有 cast_time 字段），移动中可施法且不减速。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

## Files and Code
- `scripts/core/unit_rim.gdshader`（新建，已写）：
  ```glsl
  shader_type spatial;
  render_mode blend_add, unshaded, cull_back, depth_draw_never;
  uniform vec4 rim_color : source_color = vec4(0.25, 0.85, 1.0, 1.0);
  uniform float rim_power : hint_range(0.5, 8.0) = 2.2;
  uniform float rim_strength : hint_range(0.0, 3.0) = 0.75;
  uniform float hit : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.0;
  uniform vec4 hit_color : source_color = vec4(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0);
  void fragment() {
      float f = pow(1.0 - clamp(dot(NORMAL, VIEW), 0.0, 1.0), rim_power);
      ALBEDO = mix(rim_color.rgb * rim_strength, hit_color.rgb, clamp(hit, 0.0, 1.0)) * f
          + hit_color.rgb * hit * 0.22;
      ALPHA = 1.0;
  }
  ```
- `scripts/core/blob_shadow.gdshader`（新建，已写）：render_mode unshaded/blend_mix/depth_draw_never/cull_disabled/shadows_disabled/fog_disabled；uniforms `shadow_strength`=0.30、`soft_range`=vec2(0.22,0.98)、`noise_amt`=0.10；`_hash`/`_vnoise` 低频噪声；`a = 1-smoothstep(...)` 乘噪声系数后 `clamp`；`ALBEDO=vec3(0); ALPHA=a*shadow_strength;`。

- 用户（通过 Team Lead 派发的 teammate "character-fx-dev"）要求：为 Godot 4.7 GDScript 项目 `C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king`（HonorKing，3D MOBA，mobile 渲染器，Android 目标）补齐「角色可读性」视觉批次：英雄模型 rim 边缘光、脚下接地阴影、受击闪白。只做英雄（不做小兵/塔），只做表现不改战斗逻辑，验证从简。
- 明确交付物：
  1. 新增 `scripts/core/unit_rim.gdshader`（spatial，`render_mode blend_add, unshaded, cull_back, depth_draw_never;`，uniforms `rim_color`/`rim_power`=2.2/`rim_strength`=0.75/`hit`/`hit_color`，fragment 公式已给定）。
  2. 新增 `scripts/core/blob_shadow.gdshader`（spatial，`render_mode unshaded, blend_mix, depth_draw_never, cull_disabled, shadows_disabled, fog_disabled;`，UV 软圆 alpha 内部约 0.30，可加低频噪声，输出 `ALBEDO=vec3(0); ALPHA=alpha;`）。
  3. 新增 `scripts/core/UnitVisuals.gd`（class_name UnitVisuals）：`attach_hero(unit: Node3D, team: int, model_root: Node3D) -> void`、接地阴影（"BlobShadow"，PlaneMesh (1,1)、`rotation.x=-PI/2`、`position.y=0.03`、scale=`body_radius*2.4`（缺省 0.9）、cast_shadow OFF、material_override、隐藏规则：unit 不可见/兰陵王隐身/阵亡；BlobFollower extends Node3D 每帧同步）、`flash(unit)`（rim mat `hit`→1，0.18s tween 回 0，kill 旧 tween，接口对非 Hero 节点容错，无 rim 材质时空操作）。
  4. 接入 `scripts/entities/Hero.gd` `_create_visual()`：在 `add_child(visual_mesh)`（约 835）及 fallback 分支（约 848）之后调用 attach；不得破坏兰陵王隐身、张飞变身缩放、`_set_node_alpha`。
  5. 接入 `scripts/entities/GameEntity.gd` `take_damage()`：扣血后未死亡分支调用 `UnitVisuals.flash(self)`，只加这一行逻辑。
  6. 接入 `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd`：远端英雄模型创建处（`_make_view`/`CapsuleMesh` 约 1350 附近）调用 attach_hero；在 `_prev_hp` 掉血检测处（约 3025-3035，`Hud._sync_flash`）对本地关注英雄调用 flash。
- 允许改动文件仅限上述 6 个；禁止动 `scripts/core/MapVisuals.gd`、`PostFX.gd`、`project.godot`、UI/NetSession/商店/面板文件。
- 验证要求：
  a) `cd 'C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king'; & 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --path . --editor --quit`（仅允许既有 `Class "Minimap" hides a global script class` 告警）。
  b) `... --headless --path . res://scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after 240`（不得有 SCRIPT ERROR）。
  c) 窗口化真实渲染临时探针（`res://_probe_char.tscn` + gd，用后删除），加载 `res://scenes/battle.tscn`，跑到有英雄模型后截图 `await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw` + `get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png("res://_shot_char.png")`；确认无运行时报错、青/红轮廓、脚下软阴影；**保留 `_shot_char.png`**，其它临时文件删除。
- 完成后：`send_message` 给 lead（改动摘要、接入点行号、验证结论、截图路径），然后不做别的。
- 工作流要求：先 `team_task_list` 找 task-7，`team_task_get` 后 claim，完成时 complete；若任务不存在直接开工（优先 claim）。实测 task-1..6 存在且均已 completed，**没有 task-7**，因此直接开工。

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7 mobile renderer、GDScript（4.x 语法）、spatial shaders、`material_overlay`（单层叠加、保留原贴图）、加法混合、透明-pass 深度测试。
- `class_name UnitVisuals extends RefCounted` + 静态方法 + 内部类 `BlobFollower extends Node3D`。
- `Node.get_meta(name, default)` 在键不存在时会报错（Godot 4.7 实测），需先 `has_meta`；`"prop" in object` 用于安全判断属性存在（非 Hero 客户端 Node3D 容错）。
- 联机客户端节点是纯 `Node3D`（无 Hero 实体/无 body_radius/is_dead），`Hud` 是 NetClientBattle 的内部类，无法直接访问外部 `_views`，改用 `Callable` 回调 `hero_hit_cb`。
- 项目屏幕：窗口 1600×900 / 1280×720 对应虚拟视口 (2488,1400)（content scale ≈0.643，`unproject_position` 返回虚拟坐标）。
- 地图地面高度分层：野区基底 PlaneMesh y=-0.02（顶点起伏 bump_amount=0.28，野区最高约 y=0.26）；分路平面 y=0.05；高地扇形 CSG y≈0.25；泉水圆盘顶部 y≈0.325 → 贴地 blob 必须高于这些层。
- Godot 4 PlaneMesh 默认水平（法线 +Y），不得再绕 X 旋转（与需求文字 `rotation.x=-PI/2` 冲突，已按视觉正确性改为不旋转）。

## Files and Code
- `scripts/core/unit_rim.gdshader`（新建，已写）：
  ```glsl
  shader_type spatial;
  render_mode blend_add, unshaded, cull_back, depth_draw_never;
  uniform vec4 rim_color : source_color = vec4(0.25, 0.85, 1.0, 1.0);
  uniform float rim_power : hint_range(0.5, 8.0) = 2.2;
  uniform float rim_strength : hint_range(0.0, 3.0) = 0.75;
  uniform float hit : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.0;
  uniform vec4 hit_color : source_color = vec4(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0);
  void fragment() {
      float f = pow(1.0 - clamp(dot(NORMAL, VIEW), 0.0, 1.0), rim_power);
      ALBEDO = mix(rim_color.rgb * rim_strength, hit_color.rgb, clamp(hit, 0.0, 1.0)) * f
          + hit_color.rgb * hit * 0.22;
      ALPHA = 1.0;
  }
  ```
- `scripts/core/blob_shadow.gdshader`（新建，已写）：render_mode unshaded/blend_mix/depth_draw_never/cull_disabled/shadows_disabled/fog_disabled；uniforms `shadow_strength`=0.30、`soft_range`=vec2(0.22,0.98)、`noise_amt`=0.10；`_hash`/`_vnoise` 低频噪声；`a = 1-smoothstep(...)` 乘噪声系数后 `clamp`；`ALBEDO=vec3(0); ALPHA=a*shadow_strength;`。
- `scripts/core/UnitVisuals.gd`（新建，已写并多次修改）：
  - `const RIM_SHADER/BLOB_SHADER` preload；`RIM_TEAM0=Color(0.25,0.85,1.0)`、`RIM_TEAM1=Color(1.0,0.4,0.32)`、`RIM_STRENGTH=0.8`、`HIT_TIME=0.18`、`BLOB_Y=0.36`。
  - `static func attach_hero(unit, team, model_root)`：已挂载 `_fx_rim_mats` 则 return；递归收集 MeshInstance3D 每 mesh 独立 ShaderMaterial 设 `material_overlay` 并记 `_fx_rim_mats`；BlobShadow 用 PlaneMesh size(1,1)、material_override、cast_shadow OFF、gi_mode DISABLED、`position=(0, BLOB_Y=0.36, 0)`、`scale=radius*2.4`（Hero body_radius=1.5 → 3.6；缺省 0.9）；`BlobFollower` 子节点每帧按 `is_visible_in_tree`/`is_dead`/`display_name=="兰陵王" and lanling_stealth_active` 设 shadow.visible。
  - `static func flash(unit)`：mats 遍历 set hit=1；`has_meta("_fx_hit_tween")` 后 kill 旧 tween；`unit.create_tween()` + `set_parallel(true)` + 每材质 `tween_property(m, "shader_parameter/hit", 0.0, 0.18)`；不在树内直接回 0。
- `scripts/entities/Hero.gd`（已改）：在 fallback 赋值后、`var col = CollisionShape3D.new()` 前插入：
  ```gdscript
  # 角色可读性：rim 边缘光 + 脚下接地软阴影（仅 material_overlay / 独立子节点，不改原材质）
  UnitVisuals.attach_hero(self, team, visual_mesh)
  ```
  （`_ready` 第 686 行调用 `_create_visual()`；team 在 `setup()` 中先于 add_child 赋值，安全）
- `scripts/entities/GameEntity.gd`（已改）：`take_damage()` 内 `health -= actual` / `_damage_feedback` 之后插入：
  ```gdscript
  # 受击闪白（仅对有 rim overlay 的英雄生效；其它实体空操作）
  UnitVisuals.flash(self)
  ```
- `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd`（已改）：
  - `_make_view()` 中 `match` 结束后、英雄脚下队伍环前插入：`if typ == NET_HERO: UnitVisuals.attach_hero(node, team, node)`（约 1340-1342 行）。
  - `Hud` 内新增 `var hero_hit_cb := Callable()`；`_sync_flash()` 血量下探分支内加 `if str(r.get("kind","")) == "hero" and hero_hit_cb.is_valid(): hero_hit_cb.call(nid)`（约 3108-3113 行）。
  - `_build_hud()` 中 `_hud.hero_hit_cb = _on_net_hero_hit`；新增顶层方法 `_on_net_hero_hit(nid: int)`：`_views.get(nid)` → `UnitVisuals.flash(v.get("node"))`。
- 临时探针文件（待删除）：`_probe_char.gd`、`_probe_char.tscn`（加载 battle.tscn，`-- --net-test` 自动开局，fov=40，把玩家英雄移到 `(-52,0,52)` 避开泉水盘，冻结英雄物理/动画后截 `_shot_char.png`、`_shot_base.png`、`_shot_hit.png`、`_shot_debug.png` 并打印 hero 的 rim/blob 数据）；`_probe_fx.gd`、`_probe_fx.tscn`（静态微场景：WorldEnvironment+DirectionalLight3D+Ground PlaneMesh+固定 Camera3D，亚瑟 team0 x=-3.5、小乔 team1 x=0、兰陵王 team1 x=3.5，截 `_fx_shot.png`/`_fx_base.png`/`_fx_hit.png`，验证 stealth/dead 阴影隐藏）。
- 日志临时文件：`_probe_log.txt`、`_probe_fx_log.txt`。
- 输出图：`_shot_char.png`（1600×900，保留交付）、`_shot_base.png`、`_shot_hit.png`、`_shot_debug.png`、`_fx_shot.png`、`_fx_base.png`、`_fx_hit.png`（后六者待删）。另有他人既有 `_shot_postfx*.png`，不得删除。

## Errors and Fixes
- `get_meta("_fx_hit_tween", null)` 报 `ERROR: The object does not have any 'meta' values with the key '_fx_hit_tween'.` → 改为 `if unit.has_meta("_fx_hit_tween")` 再读取，已修复。
- 首版 `.gdshader` 中 `rotation.x=-PI/2` 若用于 PlaneMesh 会立起（PlaneMesh 默认已水平）→ 不旋转，仅注释说明。

- 按 CLAUDE.md 交付前执行 Windows 通知：`pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · 角色可读性" -Message "..."`。
- 任务板无 task-7，无需 claim/complete（可说明）。

- 已把 `BLOB_Y` 改为 0.36 并重跑 battle 探针；最新像素分析确认玩家英雄区域：
  - rim 正 diff 9060 px，bbox (759-887, 250-381)，mean drgb `[0.1, 18.0, 36.2]`（青色方向）。
  - 阴影负 diff 9723 px，bbox (820-925, 270-461)，mean drgb `[-11.7,-12.3,-11.6]`（脚下方）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

Also AI recover `_start_casting(4, ...)`: windup for recover skill type? skill index 4 recover type maybe 6 (shield) → 0.10s windup; if during another windup, ignored without CD loss (AI sets CD inside finish? recover path `_use_summoner` separate; here casting slot 4 may hit `_finish_casting` and set CD). Guard prevents waste. Good.

But another: 兰陵王 stealth `_try_cast_lanling_stealth` sets cooldown first — add guard.

Also `_try_cast_lanling_stealth` calls `_start_casting` which may early-return due to prereq? no.

Let me add guard.

Another issue: `_cancel_cast_windup` clears `channeling_skill_index`, but for 沈梦溪 channeling? exempt zero windup so cancel not triggered by windup (casting_skill false quickly). fine.

Next: consider `is_ai` attacks while moving - AI unchanged (we return early). But `net_taken` AI (is_ai=true, net_taken=true) passes; `_get_attack_target` for is_ai uses net branch: manual_target from NetSession? NetSession sets `net_attack_hold`; good.

Now: probe headless? Let's first add the 兰陵王 guard.

Those errors appeared from frame 0 (line 11 onwards) — maybe from BattleManager._process each frame. But more critically, maybe those errors abort parts of BattleManager._process (script error stops that function for the frame), leaving game in weird state? But why walkA moved=0? Input action ui_up release etc; maybe `_handle_attack_wheel_input`/`_handle_attack_priority_input`? Hmm.

for h in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("heroes"):

{"command":"$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'; & 'C:\Users\18749\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe' -c @'
p="_probe_feel.gd"
s=open(p,encoding="utf-8").read()

s=s.replace('''	print("[FEEL] standA(1.2s) attacks=%d dummy_dmg=%.0f" % [attacks2, dh_stand - dummy.health])''','''	print("[FEEL] standA(1.2s) attacks=%d dummy_dmg=%.0f" % [attacks2, dh_stand - dummy.health])

	# A2. 移动中「锁定目标」不出手键也普攻
	player.manual_target = dummy
	var attacks3 := 0
	var dh_lock: float = dummy.health
	prev_timer = player.attack_timer
	Input.action_press("ui_up")
	var l0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	for i in range(60):
		await get_tree().physics_frame
		if player.attack_timer > prev_timer + 0.05:
			attacks3 += 1
		prev_timer = player.attack_timer
	Input.action_release("ui_up")
	var lock_moved: float = player.global_position.distance_to(dummy.global_position)
	print("[FEEL] lockWalk(1.0s) attacks=%d dist=%.2f dummy_dmg=%.0f" % [attacks3, lock_moved, dh_lock - dummy.health])
	player.manual_target = dummy''')

s=s.replace('''	print("[FEEL] recast frames=%d cd=%.2f mana %.0f->%.0f dmg=%.0f" % [
		f2, player.skill_cooldowns[idx], mana2, player.mana, dh2 - dummy.health])''','''	for i in range(48):
		await get_tree().physics_frame
	print("[FEEL] recast frames=%d cd=%.2f mana %.0f->%.0f dmg_after_0.8s=%.0f" % [
		f2, player.skill_cooldowns[idx], mana2, player.mana, dh2 - dummy.health])''')

open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8",newline="\n").write(s)
print("patched3")
'@","description":"Add locked-target walk test and delayed damage check"}

分析任务（只读，不改任何文件）：逐个英雄排查「技能动画/表现设计」，产出紧凑表给 lead。

范围：**吕布、亚瑟、马超、铠、不知火舞、甄姬、狄仁杰、太乙真人、东皇太一、李白、兰陵王、孙尚香、马可波罗、张飞**（14 个）。

参考文件：`scripts/core/SpellFxTable.gd`（16 个签名大招 + 8 英雄道具）、`scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd`（`play_spell` 与通用形状）、`assets/SkillDataBase.gd`（技能名/type/专属执行）、`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`（动画 clip 规则）、`scripts/entities/HeroPassive.gd`。已知数据：hero_configs 里各英雄 skills 列表；`_cast_anim_name` 仅 5 种 clip；`CAST_ANIM_MELEE`/`CAST_ANIM_TWOHAND` 决定用哪套。

1) 一张表：`英雄 | 技能1 | 技能2 | 技能3(大招) | 动作clip | 专属表现(文件:行) | 主要问题`，每格 ≤20 字，专属表现写行号即可。

不要弹通知、不要改文件、不要启动游戏窗口；总字数控制在 1200 字内。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.
